experiment.research_claim: Exploratory oracle-free, contract-aware capability analysis of a production-grade consensus library without source modification or scoring against a human answer key.

system_boundary.description: Analyze the standalone go.etcd.io/raft/v3 library at its pinned repository revision. Public protocol state-machine APIs, Ready processing, Storage interfaces and implementations shipped in this module, membership changes, and asynchronous storage-write behavior are inside the boundary. Real network transport, external durable disk or WAL implementations, application state machines, process supervision, and the etcd server are outside the boundary.
